While Vyce held a clandestine meeting with the Dark Knights at Phidoch Castle, Catiua tried to convince {hero} to throw down his sword and seek safer lands. However, {hero} was determined to continue fighting for the people.
On the Trail of Xaebos
A prisoner of war revealed information about the whereabouts of High Commander Xaebos, who had led the Galgastani army to defeat at Coritanae Keep. The prisoner also told of his horrible intentions.
{hero} tried unsuccessfully to dissuade Catiua from returning to Golyat. Catiua revealed a startling secret about their missing father, Abuna Prancet.
Exarch Brantyn

News of the fall of Coritanae Keep reached Brantyn Morne in Heim. Brushing aside the opposition of his Dark Knight keeper, Volaq, Brantyn ordered an attack on Almorica. Just then, a man identifying himself as an envoy from the Resistance arrived.
The Defeated General
Though now without a kingdom to fight for, Sir Xaebos intended to see his duties through to the end. He spoke to Nybeth and Cressida of the Galgastani ideals, and assigned them a final task.
Conviction

The remaining Galgastani forces were finally defeated at the ice-bound Brigantys Castle, ending the Hierophant's mad ambitions once and for all. {hero} stood before the Galgastani refugees living at the keep, and spoke of his convictions.
Ronwey's Ploy
Vyce returned to Almorica from his diplomatic mission to Phidoch Castle. Another treaty was to be forged with the Dark Knights, calling for them to remain neutral ahead of war with the Bakram.
The Burnham Massif Trail

{hero} planned to attack Rhime to prevent a treaty between the Dark Knights and the Resistance, but was unsure of the best route to march on Rhime unnoticed. An elderly man familiar with the region was called on to help.

Duke Ronwey held audience with the Dark Knight Lanselot at an abandoned church in Rhime to discuss the war ahead. The meeting was short-lived, however, as Bakram soldiers stormed the church. Vyce approached the Duke, having betrayed him to further his own ambitions.
Begging for Quarter

Vyce and Brantyn's plan ended in failure, as although Duke Ronwey was slain, they failed to dispatch the Dark Knight Lanselot. During the sortie Vyce found himself at the end of Lanselot's blade, and begged that his life be spared.
A New Leader
Having lost the Duke through Vyce's treachery, the Walister Resistance was on the verge of collapse, and many defected. The Resistance leadership appointed {hero} as the Duke's successor.
Reunited with the Xenobians

{hero} was reunited with Sir Mirdyn, Sir Gildas, and Star Seer Warren of Xenobia, who had narrowly escaped Rhime with their lives. Warren was grievously wounded and remained in a deep sleep, but Mirdyn and Gildas offered to continue the fight alongside {hero}.

The Dark Knight twins Dame Ozma and Sir Oz were tasked with rounding up the last Liberation Front forces at Boed Fortress. Liberation Front leader Cerya was the sole survivor of their attack. She revealed to {hero} that his father Abuna Prancet yet lived.

The Resistance assailed the disorganized Bakram and Dark Knight forces, successfully storming Phidoch Castle. During the battle {hero} came face to face with Catiua, who had joined forces with Loslorien.
Vyce's End

After failing to kill the Dark Knight Lanselot, Vyce fled to Heim in the hope of gaining Regent Brantyn Morne's protection. However, Brantyn feared that his ties with the Dark Knights would be compromised, and so used Vyce as a scapegoat. Vyce was executed the following morning.

It had been four weeks since the Bakram invasion. After returning from Heim, the Dark Knight Lanselot sought to prevent any rash actions from Brantyn by monitoring him more closely. Meanwhile, he ordered the destruction of the Liberation Front. The true intentions of the Lodissians remained unclear.

Vyce devised a plan to overcome their position of disadvantage before a decisive battle with the Galgastani. Vyce was to serve as a decoy and draw the enemy away while other forces assailed Coritanae Keep from the rear to overwhelm the Hierophant's guard. Catiua voiced strong opposition to the plan.
Familiar Friends

The final confrontation with the Galgastani had begun, and the main body of troops were already moving to the Psonji Weald. Before departing for battle, the three friends from Golyat came together once more.
Family Honor
Sir Hektor, defender of the besieged Brigantys Castle and head of the Didarro family, spoke of his loyalty to the Kingdom of Galgastan. He went to his death knowing he had upheld his family's honor.
The Brigantys Dissidents

Brigantys Castle, in the heart of the frigid Brigania Flats, served as a prison for political criminals and partisans opposing Hierophant Balbatos. {hero} met with the dissidents after liberating the castle, but only confirmed that their interests were at odds.

Brigantys Castle, in the heart of the frigid Brigania Flats, served as a prison for political criminals and partisans opposing Hierophant Balbatos. {hero} met with the dissidents after liberating the castle, and confirmed that they shared a common cause.
Assault on Coritanae Keep
Hierophant Balbatos was at first elated at his victory over the Walister Resistance at the Psonji Weald. However, he was dismayed to learn that the Psonji forces were only a diversion.
As Vyce's diversionary troops faced defeat at the Psonji Weald, a second force crossed the Brigania Flats to assault Coritanae Keep. His fate sealed, the Hierophant took his own life.
Xaebos's Fury

Though suffering losses at the Psonji Weald, the Galgastani emerged victorious, and then advanced on Krysaro. Their high commander Sir Xaebos was torturing the captured Vyce when he heard that Coritanae Keep had fallen.

As Coritanae Keep fell, the Liberation Front headquarters at Boed Fortress was captured by the Dark Knights. Dame Ozma and Sir Oz annihilated the Liberation Front forces to the last man, and Abuna Prancet once again fell into the hands of the Dark Knights.

{hero} was reunited with Sir Mirdyn, Sir Gildas, and Star Seer Warren of Xenobia, who had narrowly escaped Rhime with their lives. Warren was grievously wounded and remained in a deep sleep, but Mirdyn and Gildas offered to continue the fight alongside {hero}. Vyce also joined him once more.
A Regent Under Pressure

Regent Brantyn Morne of Heim learned that Resistance forces were steadily growing in number. Panicking at this news, Brantyn is warned against rash action by the Dark Knight Volaq, who was stationed there to watch over him.

While fighting the Bakram at the Arkhaiopolis of Rhime, {hero} met the blind swordsman Hobyrim. Hobyrim asked to join the Resistance to exact revenge on the Dark Knights, and {hero} welcomed him into their ranks.

While fighting the Bakram at the Arkhaiopolis of Rhime, {hero} met the blind swordsman Hobyrim. Hobyrim asked to join the Resistance to exact revenge on the Dark Knights, but {hero} graciously declined.
Phidoch Castle was soon to fall to the Resistance. Meanwhile, the Dark Knight Ozma questioned Balxephon about the blind swordsman she had seen at Rhime.
Rapprochement with Ravness

{hero} was reunited with Dame Ravness, who sought to reform Galgastan by leading a revolt against the Hierophant. She informed him of the current state of affairs in Galgastan, and learning that they shared a common goal, {hero} asked her to forgo their past differences and join him.

{hero} was reunited with Dame Ravness, who sought to reform Galgastan by leading a revolt against the Hierophant. She informed him of the current state of affairs in Galgastan, and he learned that they shared a common goal.
Ozma's Return Home

The Dark Knight Ozma left her companions to pursue the blind swordsman Hobyrim, but then met with an unexpected accident. No longer able to fulfill her duties as a knight, Ozma returned to Lodis alone.
Balxephon's Confession

The Dark Knight Ozma discovered the blind swordsman she encountered at Rhime was in fact her fiancé Hobyrim, whom she thought long dead. Ozma pressed Balxephon to reveal the truth of the matter, and he finally relented at the urging of High Champion Lanselot.
The Apocrypha

Archiereus Mreuva was accosted by his daughter Sherri at Hagia Banhamuba. She wished him to disclose the whereabouts of the Apocrypha, tomes of power hidden somewhere on the Valerian Isles. Recalling the discourse he overheard there, {hero} decided to question Mreuva further.
Hobyrim Unmasked

A Dark Knight captured by the Resistance alluded to the fact that one of their number had infiltrated the Resistance to gather information, but had instead betrayed the Lodissians. They named Hobyrim as the betrayer.
The Two Lanselots

The Holy Knight Lanselot of Xenobia, missing since the fall of Rhime, was imprisoned deep within Heim Castle. The Dark Knight Lanselot, Loslorien's high champion, appeared before his gaunt and tortured frame.
The Resistance Leader
Having led the Resistance to conquer all of southern Valeria, {hero} retired to Phidoch Castle. The shadow who had been gathering information in Heim returned to Phidoch to make his report.
The Order of Philaha
{hero} marched into Brigantys Castle unarmed to parley with the Order of Philaha. He was told by Sibyl Olivya that his father served as leader to the Order.
Father and Daughter

While meeting with the Order of Philaha at Brigantys Castle, {hero} was reunited with his father, Prancet. Now on his deathbed following torture at the hands of the Dark Knights, Prancet spoke of how he had come to raise Catiua.
Mreuva's Daughters

Sibyl Olivya, whom {hero} met at Brigantys Castle, was the daughter of Archiereus Mreuva, former head of the Order of Philaha. She told {hero} of the secret past between his father Prancet and Regent Brantyn Morne.

{hero} went to the aid of Archiereus Mreuva, who was attacked by his daughter Sherri at Hagia Banhamuba. Mreuva was at first reluctant to aid the Resistance, but he agreed to join them after hearing of Prancet's last words and seeing {hero}'s conviction.
Brantyn's Dark Dreams

Regent Brantyn Morne had been haunted by dark dreams since the death of King Dorgalua and his instatement as ruler of the Bakram. Over the past month they had grown steadily worse, and Brantyn felt uneasy about the fate that awaited him.
News of the Princess

The emissary in Heim learned the Princess had been taken to Barnicia Castle under the pretext of observing the Dark Knights' military exercises. Resistance forces began advancing into Bakram territory to rescue her.
The Stolen Sword
Hearing that Warren had recovered enough to speak, {hero} went to meet with him. Warren told him of the true reason that he and Lanselot had come to Valeria.
Deneb's Visit
The Wicce Deneb of Xenobia visited Warren in his sickbed. She quarreled with Canopus, who wished him left alone to recover, but the Wind Caller was bested in a battle of tongues.
Tartaros and Barbas
The Resistance marched on Barnicia Castle to rescue Catiua. Though Sir Barbas was eager to stand and fight, the Dark Knight Lanselot seemed to favor withdrawing from Valeria.
Catiua's Death
The Resistance descended on Barnicia Castle to liberate Catiua from the Dark Knights. Sir Lanselot was cornered in the castle, but Catiua met with an unfortunate end.

The Resistance descended on Barnicia Castle to recover Catiua from the Dark Knights. Fearing for his life, the Dark Knight Lanselot abandoned Catiua and fled from the castle. Catiua surrendered to the Resistance, and met with her brother in a disused room.
Sibling Bonds
The Princess's Declaration
After returning to Phidoch Castle, Catiua rallied the Resistance to make a final push against the Bakram and the Dark Knights.
Facing the Dynast-King

After skirmishing with the Dark Knights once again at Barnicia Castle, the Resistance began preparing for a final battle against the forces of the Bakram-Valeria Kingdom. Meanwhile, {hero} mourned the loss of Catiua.
The Dark Knight Dissenters

As the Resistance broke through the gates of Heim Castle, Dark Knight Lanselot informed Regent Brantyn Morne of his intention to return to Lodis. However, the Dark Knight Barbas drew steel against his commander, unhappy with the decisions he had made.
The Dissenters Rise Up
The Dark Knights Martym and Andoras captured Lanselot and exposed his plans, taking Brynhildr for their own.
Recovering from War
With Regent Brantyn Morne dead, war between the Bakram and the Resistance was at an end. The remaining Bakram cadre began talks with the Resistance to form a new kingdom under Princess Versalia.
With Regent Brantyn Morne dead, war between the Bakram and the Resistance was at an end. The remaining Bakram cadre began talks to form a new kingdom under Resistance leadership.
The Church by the Sea

Following the fall of Heim Castle, there was no sign of the Holy Knight Lanselot, said to have been held prisoner in its dungeon. None of the Dark Knights knew of his whereabouts. However, a shadow learned that someone resembling the knight had been seen at a nearby church.
Sherri's Sorrow

After fleeing from a skirmish with the Resistance at Hagia Banhamuba, Sherri ended up alone in an abandoned house in Balmamusa. {hero} and Olivya encountered her there by chance when seeking shelter from the rain.
Reunited with Cerya

The pirates said to be holed up in Qadriga Fortress were actually remnants of the Liberation Front, thought to have been wiped out at Boed Fortress. Though now few in number, they continued their work under the guise of pirates. Cerya and her comrades agreed to join the Resistance.
The Fusilier Lindl

{hero} rescued Fusilier Lindl, who had been attacked by the Dark Knight Martym in Grimsby. An expert with firearms, Lindl asked to join the Resistance seeking protection and vengeance against the Dark Knights.
Diego, an old sailor who went to {hero}'s aid during a battle with a band of pirates, lectured him for his short-sightedness about the impact of war.
{hero} tracked down the legendary pirate Azelstan, and asked that he help locate a treasure trove hidden at the Pirate's Graveyard that would be invaluable in bringing the war to a quick end.
Flowers of Remembrance
{hero} found a single flower lying on the fortress docks. He was told an old sailor places flowers there every year.
A Tiny Life Taken
Following the end of the war with the Bakram, a young girl was slain before Azelstan and {hero}. Azelstan was seized by a sense of impotence, but {hero} urged him to continue the fight.
Azelstan's Resolve
As {hero} engaged the fierce creatures inhabiting the Pirate's Graveyard, Azelstan came to his aid. His resolve renewed, Azelstan pledged to join the Resistance, and {hero} graciously accepted.
As {hero} engaged the fierce creatures inhabiting the Pirate's Graveyard, Azelstan came to his aid. His resolve renewed, Azelstan pledged to join the Resistance, but {hero} turned him down.
Ozma's Suspicion
After learning she had been deceived by her comrades, the Dark Knight Ozma pursued Hobyrim alone. Sir Volaq's attempts to dissuade her were unsuccessful.

Following her surrender, the Dark Knight Ozma begged Hobyrim to tell her the truth. After learning the full story, she asked permission to join Hobyrim as a member of the Resistance. {hero} put his personal feelings aside and accepted the request.

Following her surrender, the Dark Knight Ozma begged Hobyrim to tell her the truth. After learning the full story, she asked permission to join Hobyrim as a member of the Resistance, but she and {hero} failed to resolve their differences.
Oelias's Death
Sibyl Oelias was attacked by undead creatures at Balmamusa. Though {hero} was able to save her, she ultimately succumbed to her wounds.
Cressida and Nybeth
The Necromancer Nybeth, creator of undead travesties, was annoyed at the interference of Cressida and {hero}. He pit their fallen comrades against them to exact revenge.
Cressida's Confession
After being saved by {hero}, Cressida revealed she was Nybeth's daughter. Though she showed remorse for the path she had taken, {hero} could not find it in his heart to forgive her actions.
After being saved by {hero}, Cressida revealed she was Nybeth's daughter. {hero} proposed that they throw in together to stop Nybeth, but Cressida was not willing to take part.
After being saved by {hero}, Cressida revealed she was Nybeth's daughter. {hero} proposed that they throw in together to stop Nybeth, and Cressida agreed to help.
After defeating Ocionne in battle, {hero} pledged to take her into his care. He proposed that she see the fight through to the end before judging their intentions.
After defeating Ocionne in battle, {hero} pledged to take her into his care. However, she was not willing to join him.
A songstress of growing renown in Port Omish was revealed to be Iuria, sister to Canopus. An attempt to find out why Iuria had come was foiled by skirmishing pirates.
Sirene and Iuria
Deep within the Pirate's Graveyard {hero} defeated the Wicce Sirene, who had possessed Iuria's body. Following Iuria's recovery, she revealed a startling truth.
A Crippling Blow
Catiua's death came just ahead of the final battle with the Bakram. As {hero} mourned his loss, he received word that a small group of Resistance forces had been wiped out by Bakram soldiers.
The Search for Warren

Believing the sage's prophecy, Canopus, Sir Mirdyn, and Sir Gildas were set to make their way to the Palace of the Dead on Exeter in search of Warren. As soon as he heard of their plans, {hero} offered to accompany them.
The Mysterious Boy
As {hero} moved deeper into the Palace of the Dead, a mysterious boy appeared before him. The boy mentioned he sought the king there, before vanishing.
The Mysterious Boy Reappears
The mysterious boy appeared before {hero} once more, saying only that the king needed help before disappearing. No one knew of the king he referred to.
The Possessed King
As Canopus had guessed, the Palace of the Dead contained a Chaos Gate through which Warren was able to return. However, he was followed by a demonic entity that had possessed King Rodrick.
Warren's Return
After Warren returned through the Chaos Gate, he stated his intention to go back to Xenobia. {hero} asked him to attend Catiua's coronation.
Klaire and Lanselot

Klaire confided that the Holy Knight Lanselot had saved her life in the battle at Rhime, and regretted being unable to thank him at the time. {hero} also lamented being powerless to prevent what had taken place there.
The First Knight
Having recuperated from his wounds, the Holy Knight Lanselot encouraged {hero} to see more of the world beyond Valeria, and invited him to visit his homeland of Xenobia.
A Place of Memories

{hero}, Catiua, and Vyce finally found time to gather at the church in Golyat once more. They reminisced over childhood memories, and discussed how their lives had changed since the sacking of Golyat.
Quarter to Four

The raid was drawing to a close. The Dark Knights led by Sir Volaq and Sir Andoras began to target powerless civilians, determined to leave no witnesses. {hero} battled to save as many lives as he could.
Half Past Two
Dark Knights under twins Sir Oz and Dame Ozma attacked the residential quarter. {hero} fought back the Dark Knights while trying to protect the fleeing citizens.
Quarter Past One
The Dark Knights were attacking townspeople on the main thoroughfare, led by Sir Martym and Sir Barbas, who had killed Vyce's father.
Stroke of Midnight
It was midnight when the Dark Knights began the sacking of Golyat. {hero} had arrived at the beginning of it all. Unlike a year previous, he was no longer powerless to act.
The Journey
Though perhaps merely a phantasm, {hero} spoke to his father of how he had routed the Dark Knights.
The Pirate Sanctum

{hero} reached a place sacred to the pirates in the bowels of the Pirate's Graveyard, where Azelstan revealed the true nature of the pirate treasure. Learning the truth, {hero} chose to leave empty-handed.
{hero} reached a place sacred to the pirates in the bowels of the Pirate's Graveyard. Though the treasure there did not live up to his expectations, he took all of use he could find before leaving.
Deneb's Request
{hero} agreed to counsel the Wicce Deneb, who was acting uncharacteristically nervous. He soon wished he had not, but he stayed to hear her out.
Punkin's Labor Struggle
Seeing that Deneb planned to punish Punkin severely, {hero} proposed a different solution. They both accepted readily, but then began to haggle fiercely over the details.
Anniversary Celebrations

On the first of Godscale, the Bakram-Valerian Kingdom celebrated the second anniversary of its founding. Festivities were held across Heim to mark the occasion. Regent Brantyn Morne announced plans to mend damage done to the Hanging Gardens in the war.
Five Perish During Procession

A great tragedy has taken place during Bakram-Valerian Kingdom foundation day celebrations. A procession of the Dark Knights Loslorien has met ambush.
  No Dark Knights were harmed, but a number of onlookers were caught in the conflict. Five were killed, and another twenty-one injured. It is not known who instigated the attack.
Duke's Execution Draws Near

The Kingdom of Galgastan has announced Duke Ronwey is to be executed in the coming days. The former leader of the Walister Resistance has been held at Almorica Castle since his defeat several months past.
Xenobia on the March?

It has come to light that the knights seen recently in the vicinity of Golyat hail from the Kingdom of New Xenobia to the east. Some fear they may be scouts for a coming invasion, though they deny any such charge. They have taken up with a band of rebels, and a close eye will be kept on their conduct.
Almorica Castle Falls

Remnants of the Walister Resistance have recaptured Almorica Castle from Galgastani forces. Duke Ronwey was freed, and the Galgastani have been forced to withdraw from the region. Both camps will be watched with great interest.
A Hero is Born

Almorica Castle was recently recaptured by Resistance partisans, who defeated the occupying Galgastani forces.
  None of the partisans were more than a score in years. Their leader, Pavel, is now celebrated as a hero by the Walister people.
Resistance Takes Krysaro

The town of Krysaro near Almorica's border is now under Walister Resistance control. Before their coming Krysaro had become a ghost town strewn with corpses, but residents are now beginning to return.
  Krysaro has long been a center of worship for followers of Vasque, and it is but a matter of time before it returns to its former glory.
Bloody Purges in Coritanae

Opponents of the Galgastani regime in Coritanae held a large rally upon hearing that Almorica Castle had fallen.
  Many have been secretly critical of Hierophant Balbatos, and now this discontent has come to the fore. The Hierophant is responding with force, slaying all those who speak out against him.
Procession Attackers Named

Partisans thought to be behind the attack of a procession in Heim on the first of Godscale have now been apprehended. They are believed to be members of the Liberation Front, a group of Bakram militants loyal to the late King Dorgalua. We now await further announcements.
Consul Obdilord Missing

Nybeth Obdilord, a well-known practitioner of the art of necromancy and the Galgastani consul to Almorica, has gone missing.
  He has not been heard from since the fall of Almorica Castle, and is likely a prisoner of the Walister Resistance. There is grave fear for his safety.
Liberation Front a Danger?

The Liberation Front is made up of Bakram partisans loyal to the late King Dorgalua. Though they promote equality regardless of ethnicity or religious beliefs, their violent tactics have been called into question following a number of civilian deaths.
  Front leader Cerya Phoraena vehemently denies any part in these killings. She states this is merely propaganda targeted at discrediting their cause.
Resistance-Bakram Alliance?

A group of Resistance forces have broken through Galgastani lines at Rhime. Sir Leonar of the Knights of Almorica is thought to be among them.
  Leonar is a senior member of the Resistance, and it is rumored he was sent as envoy to seek aid from the Bakram.
Phorampa Open to Hunting

Duke Ronwey has decreed that the Phorampa Wildwood, which has long been neglected due to the war, is to be opened to hunters. Though hunting will first be limited to the southern tracts bordering Tynemouth, other areas are to follow.
  The Walister are growing in power, but they yet lack funds. It is thought they seek to profit from Phorampa's bountiful reserves.
Massacre at Balmamusa

A massacre has taken place at Balmamusa. There are no survivors. Balmamusa was set aside for the Walister by the Kingdom of Galgastani, and all those who perished were of Walister blood. Women and children were spared no mercy as the town was engulfed in flames.
  The killings are thought to be an act of retribution by the Galgastani for the recapture of Almorica Castle by the Resistance. Hierophant Balbatos maintains he is not responsible.
Another Purge of Dissidents

Hearing of the massacre at Balmamusa, factions within the Galgastani camp have risen up against their leaders. They sought to oust the Hierophant, but army forces have crushed the rebellion with a savage display of force. Many are deserting the army or seeking to incite a coup d'état, and the chain of command is in tatters.
Hero of Golyat a Traitor?

The Walister Resistance has placed a bounty on the head of the young Hero of Golyat who recaptured Almorica Castle. They have named him as the one responsible for the massacre at Balmamusa. He has thus far evaded pursuit, and is now in hiding. The bounty stands at a staggering 30,000 goth.
Resistance Musters

Reports indicate that forces of the Walister Resistance led by Duke Ronwey are massing in the Psonji Weald near Coritanae Keep. Galgastani now make up about half the Resistance army, and the battle lines are no longer as clearly drawn as in the past. It seems a final push will be made in the coming days.
Coritanae Keep Captured!

The Walister Resistance has captured Coritanae Keep, the Galgastani seat of power. The keep was taken with little resistance, making the battle of the Psonji Weald the last major engagement of the war. Galgastani leader Hierophant Balbatos was executed the following morning.
The Bakram Invade

Bakram forces launched a new offensive on Rhime mere days after the downfall of the Kingdom of Galgastan. They now battle soldiers of the Walister Resistance garrisoned there, and both sides have suffered heavy losses. Refugees from Rhime are streaming into the Phidoch region.
Countless Civilians Killed

Another tragedy reminiscent of the massacre at Balmamusa has occurred. A great many of the townspeople of Rhime have fallen victim to the Bakram invasion. At least 5,000 are believed dead, and bodies litter the streets. With skirmishes still taking place, as yet nothing can be done to put the dead to rest.
The Massacre a Ploy?

It is now rumored Duke Ronwey had a hand in the massacre that took place in Balmamusa. Some suggest the killings were a ploy to cause internal strife in Galgastan. The Duke denies these rumors. Meanwhile, opponents of the Hierophant in Galgastan are still wary of laying the blame for the massacre on Balbatos.
Galgastani Forces Massing

Reports indicate that the Galgastani forces led by Hierophant Balbatos are massing in the Psonji Weald near Coritanae Keep. With the Resistance growing in numbers and Galgastani opponents of the war becoming more vocal, it is thought Galgastani forces will make their move soon.
A New Faction Emerges

Curious posters have been sighted in Rhime in recent days. They say simply, "The nobility must be overthrown." They are the work of the New Walister Alliance, who seek self-governance for their people. Support for this new faction is growing fast among the poorer classes, and authorities seek to unmask its leader.
Walister Forces Defeated!

A major battle has been fought between Galgastani and Walister forces at the Psonji Weald. Both sides incurred heavy losses in fighting that raged for more than a day, but the Galgastani emerged victorious. The Resistance were unfamiliar with the lay of the land, and the Galgastani clinched victory upon the arrival of reinforcements.

The Bakram had been quiet of late, but have now resumed their offensive with a surprise attack on Rhime. They battle soldiers of the Walister Resistance garrisoned there, and both sides have suffered heavy losses. Refugees from Rhime are streaming into the Phidoch region.
Ravness Loxaerion Captured

Ravness Loxaerion, sought by the Resistance for her involvement in the massacre at Balmamusa, has been captured at Port Asyton in the Kingdom of Galgastan.
  She led Resistance forces in a number of past battles, and is a bitter enemy of Galgastan. The Resistance requested she be handed over to them, but the Galgastani camp refused. She is to be escorted to Coritanae Keep where she faces execution.
Coritanae Annexed

Duke Ronwey of the Walister Resistance has met with Galgastani leaders to negotiate the dissolution of the army and the formal handover of Coritanae. This signals the end of the Kingdom of Galgastan established by Hierophant Balbatos.
Galgastani Join Resistance!

Former Galgastani soldiers are flocking to the Walister Resistance. Many of them long to end the war that has stretched on for more than two years, and they are eager to prove their mettle against the Bakram armies.
Rhime Refugees Return

A large number of refugees fled Rhime for neighboring regions when the Bakram invaded. Those who had taken up in Phidoch have started to make their way home. The Bakram claim the restoral of public order in Rhime is to thank for this, but refugees state their poor treatment at the hands of the people of Phidoch has forced them to leave.
Mount Weobry Erupts!

Mount Weobry in the Burnham Massif has erupted for the first time in six score years. The blast shook the land for miles, but tremors have now subsided.
  Though the Valerian Isles are volcanic, Mount Hedon on Banhamuba was the only known active volcano until now.
Almorica Castle Attacked!

Almorica Castle has been attacked by remnants of the Galgastani army. The Resistance suffered few losses, but were caught off guard by the late-night assault, and the castle fell.
  Elite Galgastani forces were made up of Balbatos loyalists, and most have continued to fight. Though Coritanae has been annexed, it will be some time before the Resistance wins the hearts of its people.
Record 50,000 Goth Bounty

Vyce Bozeck, once a top member of the Resistance, now has a bounty of 50,000 goth on his head. This is the largest in recorded history. Vyce is accused of plotting to kill Duke Ronwey, and has not been seen for over a month. He was the childhood friend of {hero} Pavel, the Hero of Golyat.
Record 60,000 Goth Bounty

The bounty for Vyce Bozeck, wanted for plotting the assassination of Duke Ronwey, now stands at 60,000 goth.
 This is a princely sum, and bounty hunters now scour the lands for a chance at the purse.
Strange Happenings at Asyton

There have been many strange sightings at Port Asyton, gateway to the war-torn Coritanae lands. Bodies have been robbed from its cemetery, and residents thought dead have been seen on the streets. Resistance forces were dispatched to investigate, but have not been heard from since. The townspeople now avoid going out after dusk.
Coritanae Keep Captured

Remnants of the Galgastani army have captured Coritanae Keep from the Walister Resistance. The assault was led by High Commander Xaebos, a close aid of the late Hierophant Balbatos. He played a key role in the blood war, and is wanted for crimes committed against the peoples of Valeria.
Galgastani Army Reforming?

Remnants of the Galgastani army currently holed up in Coritanae Keep are now calling for fellow survivors to return to their posts. It is not known how many former soldiers have answered the call. The Galgastani also plan to execute several Walister Resistance soldiers in the days to come, including wanted criminal Vyce Bozeck.
Galgastani Army Annihilated

Resistance forces have once again captured Coritanae Keep. High Commander Xaebos was slain in the battle. The Galgastani stragglers who had continued fighting the Resistance are now no more. Peace has returned to Coritanae at last. The whereabouts of former Resistance soldier Vyce Bozeck who had been held at the castle are not known.
Hero of Golyat Returns!

Coritanae Keep has been wrested from the hands of High Commander Xaebos. The keep was liberated by {order} under the command of former Walister Resistance soldier {hero} Pavel, also known as the Hero of Golyat.
  All are curious at what Pavel's next move may be.
Brigantys Castle Falls

Brigantys Castle has been captured by remnants of the Galgastani army. High Commander Xaebos leads the survivors, and is urging other Galgastani soldiers to regroup, but few have answered the call. It is thought the Walister Resistance will move to recapture the castle quickly.

Brigantys Castle has been liberated by the Hero of Golyat, {hero} Pavel. High Commander Xaebos was slain in the battle. The Galgastani stragglers who had continued fighting the Resistance are now no more.
  It is not known why {hero} Pavel would aid the Resistance, who have put a price on his head.
Coritanae Falls to Resistance!

Resistance forces have captured Coritanae Keep in {hero} Pavel's absence. Duke Ronwey has stated that Pavel will be shown no mercy, despite appearances that he may be seeking to rejoin the Resistance.
  It seems that peace still eludes Coritanae.
Storm Strikes Oedlark

A storm is raging off the coast of Oedlark. The waters around the island are known for their fickle currents, and the storm has only made these worse. The approach to the undersea caverns called the Pirate's Graveyard is currently too treacherous to navigate.
  Though thought to be a temporary anomaly, pirates in these parts whisper that the storm was called by a creature of the deep.
A Kingdom Rises

King {hero} announced his intention to establish a provisional government at Heim. King {hero} is set to rule, having the backing of both Resistance leaders and the general populace. The king's close associates will be part of the new administration.
  He has also announced the Resistance is to be dissolved. With war at an end and the Dark Knights destroyed, the Resistance no longer serves a purpose. Its soldiers will join the king's guard or be assigned other posts to ensure they are rewarded for the service they have given.
  Heim Castle is bustling with the preparations for King {hero}'s coronation.
The Heim Conflict Ends

With the Heim Conflict that erupted following the death of King Dorgalua at an end, King Tristan of the Kingdom of New Xenobia pledged to support King {hero} in restoring the isles to their former glory. It is rumored that his envoys have already been sent to Heim.
  The Holy Lodissian Empire has made no comment thus far. With the collapse of the Bakram-Valerian Kingdom they had lent aid to through a secret treaty, they surely cannot remain silent for much longer. Interestingly, it seems the destruction of the Dark Knights has yet to be announced in Lodis.
The Tigers Stir

Though the war in Valeria is at an end, bands of armed militia still roam the lands. The Tigers of Burnham is one such group. Based in the Burnham Highlands, they have been implicated in a number of assassinations.

 They recently claimed that King {hero} drove Princess Versalia to her grave to usurp her power, and stated their intention to capture Heim from the Resistance to restore rightful order.
  Though they fight under the banner of justice for all Valerians, former Bakram and Galgastani soldiers are joining their ranks in droves, and doubts have been cast on their motives.

Valeria has a thriving sea trade, and many fortresses have been built to protect its ports from enemies. This has led to an increase in pirates, bandits, and army stragglers capturing the fortresses for their own use. Gecho Fortress on Beneceunga fell into pirate hands just the other day.
  As Gecho is south of the prominent trading port of Grimsby, merchants there are anxious to see the pirates routed from the fortress as soon as possible.
Galgastani Sighted at Lhazan

Rumor has it that remnants of the Galgastani army are gathering at Lhazan Fortress, site of the recent Bakram massacre of Vasque faithful. The Galgastani soldiers' plans are not known, but they could seek to use the fortress as a stronghold to fight the Resistance.
Duke Ronwey Assassinated!

Duke Ronwey was slain at Almorica Castle while Resistance and Bakram forces battled at Rhime. A close ally, Sir Leonar, was behind the killing. Since the massacre at Balmamusa there had been growing concern about the Duke's ability to lead, and this ultimately led to his demise.
New Leader Helms Resistance!

A new leader of the Walister Resistance has emerged following the Duke's death. The Hero of Golyat, {hero} Pavel, who acted swiftly to put down Leonar's rebellion, now heads the Resistance. {hero} has also allied with the New Walister Alliance, which enjoys a great deal of support among the people.
Galgastani Gather Strength

Reports indicate that the Galgastani forces led by Hierophant Balbatos are massing in the Psonji Weald south of Coritanae Keep. They are likely to strike while the Resistance is preoccupied with the Bakram invasion of Rhime and the change of leadership following Sir Leonar's assassination of the Duke.

The Galgastani seat of power, Coritanae Keep, has fallen. It seems Resistance soldiers battling the Galgastani at the Psonji Weald were merely decoys, as another force led by the Hero of Golyat, {hero} Pavel, assailed the undermanned keep. Galgastani leader Hierophant Balbatos was killed in the fighting.

Many Galgastani soldiers surrendered to the Walister Resistance following the death of Hierophant Balbatos. The Resistance took control of major cities such as Port Asyton and the mining town of Balmamusa. As the Galgastani forces sent to the Psonji Weald remain at large, surrendering soldiers are held as prisoners of war to prevent them joining the fray again.
Xaebos Captures Almorica

The Resistance stronghold Almorica Castle has fallen to Galgastani stragglers. The assault was led by High Commander Xaebos, a close aid of the late Hierophant Balbatos. He played a key role in the blood war, and is wanted for crimes committed against the peoples of Valeria. He has also taken Resistance officer Vyce Bozeck prisoner.
Galgastan is No More!

Almorica Castle has been liberated by Resistance forces. High Commander Xaebos was slain in the battle. The Galgastani stragglers who had continued fighting the Resistance are now no more. This signals the end of the Kingdom of Galgastan established by the late Hierophant Balbatos.
Lord of Coritanae Missing

The Lord of Coritanae, premier of the Kingdom of Galgastan, has gone missing. Hierophant Balbatos has declared the Lord kidnapped by those seeking to exploit his position. The search is ongoing.
  No strangers were sighted in the vicinity of the Lord's quarters, nor have any traces of an intruder been found, so authorities believe it the work of an insider. Denizens of the keep fear greatly for their Lord's safety, and worry at reports of the Resistance's advance.

San Bronsa Ruins Discovered

The Bay of Gobanda is known for the thick fog that hangs over its waters. It was recently discovered that an immense tower lies hidden within the fog.
  Scholars from the Royal Academy say it once stood in the ancient city of San Bronsa, which was destroyed in Dorgalua's great war. The Bay of Gobanda was formed when magic wielded by King Rodrick of Brigantys shattered the lands in the last days of the war, also destroying San Bronsa.
  Scholars had studied the tower before the great war, but it is still not known when it was built, or by whom. It is said the Hanging Gardens built by King Dorgalua were inspired by the tower of San Bronsa.
  As news of the tower's discovery spreads there is concern it will be looted by thieves, and the Resistance is considering sending an exploratory party there. There have been further reports of a large island floating in the sky above the bay, but nothing more is known at this point.
The Bending of Time

Many strange rumors have been circulating of late. People thought dead have been seen walking about, and the same person sighted in two places at once. Normally little stock would be put into such rumors, but there is much talk about these incidents among scholars and mages. Some believe them the work of the Apocrypha, others attribute them to some arcane art brought from Lodis.
  A common thread is found throughout these reports. The young hero of the Resistance, {hero}, is always mentioned by witnesses.
  {hero} is famed as a warrior and tactician, but few know of his penchant for collecting tarot cards. He is apparently particularly fond of the Wheel of Fortune card. It is not clear how this relates to the current rumors, but the Wheel of Fortune card has long been a symbol of regret and atonement in Valeria. It would not be beyond reason for {hero} himself to be struggling with such feelings, having experienced war at such a young age.
  What would one do if the power to bend time fell into our hands? One could repeat an exercise, knowing the best solution in advance. Or learn a lover plans to leave you before they speak a word. And who would not go back to save the lives of fallen comrades?
  However, one thing must be kept in mind: A different past is no guarantee of a happier future. Changing what has happened may in fact have no effect at all on the here and the now.
Iuria's Requiem

The songstress Iuria has won great fame for her talents, but since her arrival death seems to stalk the sick and weak in Omish. The requiems she sings when the dead are laid to rest may bring tears with their beauty, but some believe her to be the dreaded Wicce Sirene.
The Palace of the Dead

A stone tablet found at the Palace of the Dead on Exeter this month past has been deciphered. Scholars at the Royal Academy announced the tablet to contain the message, "A sealed door lies three floors below ground." This discovery already appears to be common knowledge among treasure-hunting thieves.
The Lost Draconic Magic

In the ancient Bolsenian era, the Dragon Lords built a civilization that flourished across Xytegenia and the surrounding isles. They are said to be the source of the magic practiced today, but much of this knowledge perished with them. On rare occasions arcana from this era are discovered at ancient ruins, and these are highly sought after.

Return of the Princess

A ceremony celebrating Princess Versalia's return to power was held at Heim Castle. Bakram officials who served King Dorgalua, including Regent Brantyn Morne, pledged their allegiance to the Princess. Lord Tartaros also attended as representative of High Priest Sardian of the Holy Lodissian Empire, reaffirming the alliance between the two nations.
Resistance Falters

{order}, which incorporates soldiers of the former Walister Resistance and the armies of Galgastan, appears to be faltering.
  Still known as the Resistance, they pledge to fight the Bakram, but following the capture of Phidoch Castle a stalemate has been reached, and some of their number now believe the war to be futile. We will keep a close watch on further developments.
Order of Philaha Rises

The Order of Philaha was divided by infighting following the death of King Dorgalua, with current leader Regent Morne ousting Archiereus Mreuva. However, Mreuva has gained many supporters since his removal, and a great number of followers wish him reinstated when Princess Versalia returns to power.
Resistance and Order Unite

Archiereus Mreuva was leader of the Order of Philaha during the rule of King Dorgalua. He was ousted by Regent Morne, who was Exarch at the time, and fled Heim to continue his work alone. It has recently come to light that Mreuva has joined forces with the Resistance. Mreuva is immensely popular, and will serve as a strong ally to the Resistance.
Resistance on the March!

Resistance forces are advancing on Heim. A large Bakram contingent has also been seen leaving the capital. However, no Dark Knights accompany the Bakram, lending weight to rumors of a falling out between them. The armies will soon clash head to head.
Mysterious Blast on Exeter

A mysterious blast has been heard on Exeter, an island northwest of the Valerian mainland. Exeter is the site of the dungeon known as the Palace of the Dead. Many have entered its halls seeking riches, but the few who have returned did so empty handed. Some believe the blast to be magical in nature.
Legend of the Ogre Battle

In times long past, mankind was engaged in a bitter battle with the forces of evil for supremacy over the land. Man drew strength from their gods, while the forces of evil suckled at the power of the Abyss. In the end, the people could do nothing against the overwhelming might of evil, and were pushed to the brink of destruction.
  It was at this time a group of three knights and twelve sages descended from the heavens and sealed the Chaos Gate that linked our world with the Abyss. The tide was turned, and man emerged victorious. Thus man came to rule and build the civilizations that stand today.
  The battle won, the three knights returned to the heavens, while the twelve sages remained to spread knowledge among the people. However, a burden yet weighed on their hearts. When the forces of evil fled, they foretold another Ogre Battle would occur. One of the knights bestowed a sword upon man that would grant the power to call the gods once more.
  The sword's name was Brynhildr. It is said he who wields the blade can speak with the gods, and travel to the heavens and the Abyss. The sword became an object of worship, and was hidden away until a second Ogre Battle saw need of its powers.
Princess Dead as Barnicia Falls

Upon hearing that Princess Versalia was held captive by the Dark Knights, the Resistance launched an attack on Barnicia Castle. Though the castle was captured, the Princess was slain by the Dark Knights before she could be rescued. The Dark Knights face outrage for their reckless actions. Loslorien themselves deny the allegations.
Princess Rescued at Barnicia

Upon hearing that Princess Versalia was held captive by the Dark Knights, the Resistance launched an attack on Barnicia Castle. The castle was captured, and the Princess is now safely back in Resistance hands. The Dark Knights claim the Resistance are holding the Princess as a prisoner of war, but the Princess denies this.
Rhamsen Wreck Raised

Salvage work has begun on the wreck of the Rhamsen, which sank in a storm off Legat. The Rhamsen was a merchant vessel bound from Balboede to the south. Thankfully the mostly Balboeden crew escaped unharmed, but their precious cargo sank with the ship. The Dark Knights are assisting with the recovery of the lost cargo.
Heim Castle Falls

Heim Castle has been captured. Brantyn Morne, ruler of the Bakram-Valerian Kingdom, was slain in the battle for the castle. Bakram soldiers throughout the lands have surrendered together with senior Bakram leaders. This brings an end to the war that has raged since the death of King Dorgalua.
Loslorien Take Flight

Loslorien and Bakram soldiers yet to yield to the Resistance have taken refuge at the Hanging Gardens. The Hanging Gardens is a tower of eighteen floors built during the reign of King Dorgalua, with lush greenery on each floor fed by ever-flowing fountains.
Traitor in the Resistance?

After the fall of Heim Castle, a curious rumor spread among the captured Dark Knights. They claim a Loslorien knight had infiltrated the Resistance. The Resistance is looking into the matter, as if there is truth to the rumor, it may mean one of their own is working against them.
The Songstress of Omish

An enchanting winged songstress has arrived in Port Omish, a town of ruffians and rogues. People flock to hear her angelic voice day upon day.
  It is rare to see winged womenfolk in those parts, and she has become quite a spectacle.
Pirates of Qadriga Fortress

Public order in Valeria is at an all time low due to the lengthy war. It is now commonplace for caravans to be beset by bandits, and pirates attack merchant vessels with abandon. The protection of sea trade is of particular import to Valeria, so a solution must be found soon. Qadriga Fortress is said to be one of many pirate strongholds scattered across Valeria.
The Bandits of Neimrahava

There have been a number of raids on caravans near the town of Grimsby on Legat, known as a center for trade. Grimsby has long fended off bandits with the fortifications built across the town, but now raiders are said to attack from the sky. The bandits are believed to be camped in the Neimrahava Wood outside town.
Port Omish, Den of Thieves

Law and order has suffered due to the lengthy war, but one town has been a haven for lawlessness since the rule of King Dorgalua. Southwest of Qadriga Fortress lies Ubeia, site of the outlaw's haven called Omish.
  Omish has a long history as a stopover port for sea traders, but over time it became a haunt for pirates, and it now operates under its own laws. It is also home to many criminals and former soldiers seeking anonymity, as well as refugees who lost their homes in Dorgalua's great war.

On the island of Oedlark off the southernmost tip of Valeria are a series of undersea caverns known as the Pirate's Graveyard. They are legendary among treasure hunters, said to hold untold riches in their depths.
  The caverns are known for one other thing: countless pirates and thieves have sought to claim the treasures of the cavern as their own, but most lose their lives before even setting foot inside.
  Currents from the south and northwest converge in the waters surrounding the Pirate's Graveyard, and its reefs make navigation difficult for all but the most skilled sailors.
  Upon reaching the caverns explorers must contend with all manner of deadly creatures, and it is littered with the corpses of failed adventurers. It is no wonder that none have yet claimed the treasures said to lie within.
The Dread Pirate

Many pirates and treasure hunters have lost their lives at the Pirate's Graveyard. Only one man has returned from its depths alive. The Dread Pirate Azelstan is known throughout the Obero Sea.
  Boasting superb navigation skills and uncommon prowess with the sword, he was a pirate among pirates. He was also known for his cruelty, said to have left a trail of blood wherever his ship sailed, and his name struck fear into the hearts of all.
  Soon after returning from the Pirate's Graveyard, Azelstan gave up pirating and disappeared. Many have speculated at why he retired in the years that have passed, some saying he was cursed by a spectre, others claiming his sword arm was maimed at the Pirate's Graveyard.

On the island of Oedlark off the southernmost tip of Valeria are a series of undersea caverns known as the Pirate's Graveyard. They are legendary among treasure hunters, said to hold untold riches in their depths.
  The caverns are known for one other thing: countless pirates and thieves have sought to claim the treasures of the cavern as their own, but most lose their lives before even setting foot inside.
  Currents from the south and northwest converge in the waters surrounding the Pirate's Graveyard, and its reefs make navigation difficult for all but the most skilled sailors.
  Upon reaching the caverns explorers must contend with all manner of deadly creatures, and it is littered with the corpses of failed adventurers. It is no wonder that none have yet claimed the treasures said to lie within.
  To obtain this treasure one would need a guide such as the Dread Pirate Azelstan, who navigated the deadly waters of the Pirate's Graveyard and returned from its depths unscathed.
The Ancient Temples

Six fortresses scattered across Valeria serve to protect it from foreign enemies. But few are aware that these were not built as strongholds. The fortresses were temples dedicated to the six daughters of the Great Father Philaha.
  The temple areas remain today, but the entryways from the fortifications were sealed during the reign of King Dorgalua. No one knows why the temples were sealed off, or how the seals can be broken.
Dorgalua's Great War

The fifteen years of war before Valeria was unified is known as Dorgalua's great war.
  Before the unification, Valeria was divided into the five kingdoms of Barnicia, Phidoch, Almorica, Coritanae, and Brigantys. Each sought to expand their territory, and relations were volatile to say the least.
  The great war began after Lord Clemont of Barnicia was assassinated by armed militia seeking to usurp his leadership. The delicate balance of power soon crumbled, with Phidoch gathering its military might and declaring war on Barnicia and Almorica, while Coritanae joined the fray as Almorica's ally.
  The war stretched on for eight years, with Phidoch eventually occupying Barnicia and Almorica and installing governments there. Phidoch ruler King Ramonica was a Bakram, and he began suppressing the Walister, causing friction between the peoples that continues to this day. Great numbers of partisans struggled against him.
  Phidoch attacked Coritanae, and when formerly neutral Brigantys joined the war at the behest of Coritanae, the war spread throughout the entire Valerian Isles. Fighting soon reached a stalemate, but Brigantys began secretly supporting partisan groups, who then formed a rebel army in Barnicia.
  Coritanae ruler Count Orlandeau was killed in battle, and Coritanae fell under the rule of Brigantys. The rebel army of Barnicia then turned on Phidoch. Future king Dorgalua was leader of this rebel army. Beset on both flanks by Brigantys and the rebels, Phidoch fell at last, bringing the conflict to an end.   
  King Rodrick of Brigantys agreed to a truce with Dorgalua, but the conditions favored one side greatly, and it was broken within a month. Fighting began anew. The battle between Rodrick and Dorgalua continued for another year, with Dorgalua ultimately winning victory. Valeria was united under a single ruler at last.

Towards the end of Dorgalua's great war, King Rodrick of Brigantys wielded terrible magic to break the deadlocked armies. The great power this unleashed defeated his enemies on the battlefield en masse, but slew his allies in kind. The surrounding lands were also shattered beyond recognition.
  Upon his victory over King Rodrick, King Dorgalua forbade the use of the Apocrypha, and hid them away. Knowledge of its very existence was lost to the sands of time.
A Rift in the Dark Knights

There have been rumors of discord between the Bakram and Dark Knights, and now it seems there is internal strife in the Dark Knights as well. A Bakram soldier revealed he saw Dark Knight commanders quarreling in Barnicia Castle.
  The details of the dispute are not known, but over the past weeks the Dark Knights have been linked to dishonorable acts such as the massacre at Rhime and the fall of Phidoch Castle. The Dark Knights may be looking for a scapegoat on which to lay the blame, but thus far they have remained silent on the matter.
The Balmamusa Dead

In recent memory Balmamusa has been the site of a tragic massacre, and now it bears witness to a tragedy of a different kind. Legions of walking dead now stalk the town, having appeared out of nowhere.
  It is not known where they originated. We can but hope they will be stopped before too much damage is done.
Iuria's Secret

The songstress Iuria has been the talk of the town of late, and new information about her has come to light. It seems she travels to the deadly caverns known as the Pirate's Graveyard night after night. These caverns are surrounded by treacherous waters, and are said to be a gathering place for souls of the dead.
  This suspicious behavior lends more weight to rumors that Iuria is in fact the Wicce Sirene.
The King of Brigantys

It is not commonly known that the Brigania Flats were once a lush paradise. The Bay of Gobanda was also once an inland area.
  In the final days of Dorgalua's great war, the lands were shattered by a man named Rodrick Desmoria, who was once King of Brigantys.
  He fought alongside King Dorgalua to unite Valeria, but in the end became his mortal enemy. He is known for using forbidden magic to wipe out those who opposed him. Though his reputation is marred by this, King Rodrick was an austere ruler who would not stand for injustice or compromise. He at first resolved to use the Apocrypha to aid his people, but it was this act that caused them to turn against him.
  It is said he died in captivity at Brigantys Castle after his defeat at the hands of King Dorgalua. Until his death he muttered constantly of the injustice he had suffered, and some say his spirit was called to the Palace of the Dead after his passing.
Rising From the Ashes

The war is at an end, and peace has returned to Valeria. Reconstruction work is moving at a swift pace across the lands, and although trade has not reached its previous levels, it recovers day by day. The markets once again throng with people, and fresh vegetables and fruit from far away countries line the stalls. The lively seafaring country of Valeria is back to its old self.
  Yet many still bear the wounds of war. Veterans of the fighting are left scarred, dealing with lost limbs, blindness, and paralysis.
  Princess Versalia has ordered these soldiers be granted a benefit through the Order of Philaha. This may cost up to a quarter of the kingdom's budget, and could climb to almost half if compensation for civilians is also approved.
  Those dealing with postwar matters such as these are at a loss to help those suffering trauma from the horrors they faced in the war. In many cases this trauma affects the everyday lives of victims, causing insomnia and anxiety, and it can only be alleviated through medicinal means. Sufferers sometimes turn to drink as a way of escape, and it is clear this is a problem than cannot be resolved through medical care alone.
  Archiereus Mreuva Phoraena heads a committee dealing with the postwar recovery that pledges support to all, regardless of background, class, or profession. Those seeking help should inquire at the nearest abbey.
A Monument to Peace

The motives behind many of Loslorien's activities have long been a mystery; the attack on Golyat, a town on the island of Galdochae, chief among them. According to a statement made to the Bakram by Dark Knight commander Balxephon V. Rahms, they planned the attack after learning a group of rebels conducting raids on Heim was hiding there. However, this information was later revealed to be false, and Lodis paid reparation to Golyat for the damage done during the attack.
  Now their true intentions have been revealed. Loslorien conducted the raid without Bakram help, and not one but several commanders were present. The Dark Knight Balxephon was among them, and some witnesses say they saw High Champion Tartaros as well. Even if armed militia were taking refuge there, it is questionable that so many Loslorien elite would take part.
  Despite the many victims of the tragedy at Golyat, there was no record of rebels being captured. Though attempts were made to obtain such records after the war, documents listing the names of suspected rebels were never uncovered. This can mean but one thing: the Dark Knights knew from the start that no rebels were harbored there.
  So why would they commit so brutal an act? Loslorien attacked Golyat after learning of the existence of a daughter born to King Dorgalua, most likely through Regent Brantyn Morne. It is also thought they had no intention of forming a long-term alliance with Brantyn and the Bakram. They acted under the pretense of eliminating rebel forces to conceal their true intentions.
  Yet after all their efforts, they were not able to locate the Princess in the attack. Instead, they instilled a hatred of Lodis in the Walister and created the Hero of Golyat, {hero} Pavel.
  Two years have passed since the raid on Golyat. With the war at an end, and Loslorien now back in Lodis, peace has returned to Valeria. Golyat has recovered swiftly, and few traces of the war remain. It should not be long before Golyat regains its status as Oberon's Pearl.
  In the coming days the unveiling of a monument will take place in the central plaza in Golyat. The monument was constructed at the behest of Princess Versalia to honor the memory of those who died in the attack, and remember how those precious lives brought the people of Valeria together.
  The Valerian Isles are now host to many visitors. We can but hope that those who see this new symbol of Golyat will take home with them a desire for peace.

{np}{FF 9A 04}To travel to a castle, town, or other location on the world map, place the cursor on the desired destination and press the {icon 3} button. To access the MAIN COMMAND MENU, place the cursor on your party and press the {icon 3} button.{pp}Select the PARTY command to equip your units and change classes, or browse the WARREN REPORT to learn more about the people and places of Valeria.{pp}Press the {icon 12} button to open the SYSTEM MENU. Select DATA to save your progress to the storage media, or choose OPTIONS to customize the controls.

{np}{FF 9A 04}This stronghold contains a series of areas that must be battled through in succession. You will be given the option to save your progress before proceeding to the next battle.{pp}However, you will not be able to leave the stronghold until you've completed all of the areas within, so it is highly recommended that you use different save data. Press the {icon 12} button to open the SYSTEM MENU and save your progress.

{np}{FF 9A 04}Once you've secured a castle or town, the SHOP command will become available. Shops offer equipment and arcana for sale, new units for hire, and an auction block to sell your monster units. Consider stocking up on healing items before heading into your next battle.{pp}Several new commands have also been added to the party screen. You can now DISMISS units you no longer need in your party. Once dismissed, a unit is GONE FOREVER, so think carefully before making a decision.{pp}You can also select CLASS CHANGE to change a unit to a different class. You'll need a CLASSMARK for the desired class.{pp}Finally, you can view the FINISHING MOVES of your units. Finishing moves require certain weapon skill ranks to use. See the PLAY GUIDE in the Warren Report for more details.

{np}{FF 9A 04}Before each battle you must choose which units to deploy to the battlefield. This group of units is called the BATTLE PARTY. A battle party can consist of up to 12 units, however some battlefields have a lower limit.

{np}{FF 9A 04}You will be given the option to save your progress before proceeding to the next battle. However, you will not be able to leave the stronghold until you've completed all of the areas within, so it is highly recommended that you use different save data.

{np}{FF 9A 04}You can now use the CRAFT command on the shop screen. To craft an item you will need a RECIPE and the necessary INGREDIENTS. Refer to the PLAY GUIDE in the Warren Report for more details.

{np}{FF 9A 04}The Hanging Gardens contain a series of areas that must be battled through in succession. You will be given the option to save your progress before proceeding to the next battle.{pp}However, you will not be able to leave the Hanging Gardens until you've completed all of the areas within, so it is highly recommended that you use different save data. Press the {icon 12} button to open the SYSTEM MENU and save your progress.

{np}{FF 9A 04}You can now use the WORLD TAROT!
The World Tarot allows you to move your party between various points in the game's time line.{pp}These points are called ANCHOR POINTS, and there are several scattered throughout each chapter of the game. Select WORLD TAROT from the Warren Report to view the time line and move to the desired anchor point.{pp}You will still be able to use all unlocked game features even if you move to an earlier point in the time line. Refer to the PLAY GUIDE in the Warren Report for more details.

{np}How could I have lost?
Where did I go wrong?
{np}Feh... Body's not doing as it's told. Time to pull out.

{np}Sorry, {hero}. I'm out!
And I'd better not hear any grumbling...

{np}{hero}...
The rest...I leave to you.
{np}C-Catiua...you were always the...the one.
{np}So much left...undone...

{np}{hero}... I'm sorry.
I've done all I could.

{np}I'm sorry, {hero}!
I cannot remain here.
{np}I've been nothing but selfish, and I apologize, {hero}.
{np}{hero}... I would hear your voice...one last time.
{np}Forced off the field of battle, me alone! This is to my shame...

{np}Your forgiveness, {hero}.
I cannot give my life yet!
{np}This...foreign soil is cold beneath me... Forgiveness, my sovereign.
{np}Defeat, I will mark you well...that we never meet again!
{np}I would hope it were my enemies and not my years that drive me from the field so soon.
{np}If this is my fate...I accept it.

{np}That's a deep wound...or two.
Best to leave.
{np}Feh... I'd as soon never turn my back to the enemy. But better to face flight than the cold ground!

{np}Gilbald...
Look after Iuria, for me.
{np}Well, this is it for me. It's up to you now, Lanselot.
{np}Let's hope...Lanselot can carry on the torch on in my stead...
{np}{hero}...look beyond the face...of things and people. Look to...the heart!
{np}{hero}, feel it in your bones, or not at all...
{np}{hero}... Don't force it, now. Everyone needs to call on allies...once in a while.

{np}You've my thanks, {hero}...
It was a good ride with you.

{np}Promise me, {hero}...
Promise you'll come to Xenobia.
{np}I would have fought with you to the end... My apologies.
{np}This cannot be my end... Even if I never again call myself a true knight!

{np}Do not mourn my passing...
All is as it should be.
{np}May fortune shine upon your days to come...
{np}I am sad to depart before I could see you reach...your destination.
{np}{hero}, thank you... Only a little more... The prize is close!

{np}Commander, forgive me...
This ground will be grave enough...
{np}Grah! This isn't my style to leave a battle half-fought!
{np}Sent running with more fighting left to be done! I've had better days than this...
{np}Don't stop a moment...over my corpse. Sorry I could not be of...more service.

{np}Sorry I...couldn't be of more help.
Take care of old man Warren.
{np}Dealing with Loslorien is...your charge now. I've no doubt you're equal to the task.
{np}Follow the path you believe in, {hero}...and no other.
{np}It seems I've underestimated the enemy...to my pain.

{np}I thought to wheel the skies...
Free... I would be free...
{np}{hero}, this is in your hands now. I go...to join the others.

{np}I've done all I could do...
I go without regrets.

{np}I can fight no longer...
Salve...salve for my wounds!
{np}I am sorry, {hero}... I am grateful for all you've done and yet unable to return the favor.

{np}What...have I accomplished?
Anything? Mother... Father...
{np}I'll only slow you down if I remain here.

{np}Father... Mother...
Tell me I've done the right thing.

{np}I'm sorry...Sister...
I leave my duty undone.

{np}Thank you, {hero}.
I will not forget what you have done.

{np}Peace to Valeria...
It is in your hands.
{np}Think...on peace. On what...lies beyond the battlefield.
{np}I am sorry I could not...do more, {hero}.
{np}Great Father Philaha...tears of mercy for your...foolish children.
{np}Peace to all...who live upon these islands... Peace.
{np}This is going...a bit more roughly than expected! Time for a bit of a rest.
{np}Awh... And I'd grown awfully fond of this body...
{np}Alas, when they said "beauty is fleeting" who knew they were talking about me?

{np}Time for me to leave...
Good luck, {hero}!
{np}I am sorry... I must withdraw to mend my wounds.
{np}Forgive me, my children... I am unable to fulfill my promise to you all.
{np}My sacrifice is...but a small one in the course of things.
{np}Perhaps this is my reward for taking the life of an ally... Alas, it is late for regret.
{np}I've walked a blood-drenched road all my life...now I follow it down to my final rest.
{np}May the protection of the gods always be for those who seek the light and hold true to dreams.
{np}I sold my soul to a demon for my revenge... Death holds no fear for me now.
{np}I've taken my revenge, and now I may rest...in eternity.
{np}Great Father Philaha... Hope and blessings to your dearest children.
{np}Though it insult my principles to leave now, my body is unwilling to carry on the fight.
{np}Perhaps you will fashion your...heaven on this land...though I reach my heaven first.
{np}It is not a terrible thing to lie down...to one's rest.
{np}I would have seen this...country you build with my own eyes.
{np}Cistina...where are you?

{np}I...I die, {hero}.
But you must carry on!
{np}My life matters not... As long as {hero} perseveres.
{np}All I could not accomplish, I leave to you, {hero}.
{np}I was wrong...to follow you, {hero}. I see that now.
{np}This body is no stranger to death. Do not linger on my memory... I am dust now...only dust.
{np}I've come far enough. I'm...happy to fall... A cobblestone on the path to victory.
{np}Do not dwell on my passing. I merely go on ahead... We will meet again.
{np}This is...no time to rest. But my injuries...must heal.
{np}I am sorry I ever...doubted you, {hero}.
{np}No! I cannot die here!
{np}Do not forget...Balmamusa, {hero}. Do not forget...
{np}Forget me...please... But never forget the tragedy of Balmamusa.
{np}Leonar...I did love you.
{np}I'm sorry, Brother. I've come far...but can go no farther.
{np}I have done all I wished and more... To death I go with peace...in my heart.
{np}This was unexpected. A strategic retreat may be the best course for me.
{np}This is a shame on my honor...a shame on my blade.
{np}I'd have taken his head before I went, but alas, we can't always get what we want...
{np}All the way to this island...only to fall here... Curses...
{np}Mother... You go...unavenged.
{np}I would have seen him dead... But such was not to be.

{np}This is an ill turn.
I must retreat!
{np}Such a life of shame I've led, I welcome a place to die.

{np}I knew this moment would come...
I go to the gods gladly.
{np}I hope I was able to do some of the penance I owed this world while I still had time...

{np}Still so much...to do.
And yet, I fall.
{np}This world does not exist for man alone...do not forget that.

{np}Dear people of Vasque...
I go to join you now.

{np}You'll carry on without me, eh?
You'll be fine.
{np}Me? Die? That's an ill...jest.

{np}I can still fight!
Don't leave me...

{np}I've come far enough...
You carry on, {hero}.
{np}Fitting for a mercenary to die on the field of battle...
{np}Something's not right with...my body. I'll need to rest.
{np}Oelias...I will no longer be able to...protect you.
{np}This...is the moment of release for which I have waited long.
{np}I am not sad... I merely go on to my appointed place...as any soldier would.

{np}The healing spells...too late...
There is much I yet need...do.

{np}Brother...I would have saved you.
If only I could...

{np}I am tired...very tired.
I must rest...just a moment.
{np}Please...bring peace to the dead...
{np}Back to the gods...they call for me. Ahh...Dievold...
{np}Well, this was an error. I've gone and born wounds more than I can hope to heal.
{np}Now...to start over from the beginning. Perhaps fate will smile upon me next time.
{np}I've not been so badly bruised in a good many years!
{np}Obda, Berda...I go to join you!
{np}Thanks for yer kindness, {hero}...
{np}I was not strong enough... Next time, I promise, I will not be a burden!

{np}My life...ends. Farewell...
Brother...Gilbald!
{np}If I hang on to but one shred of life, I will rise again...and fight!
{np}May the dead forgive me...and my father, both.
{np}Mother...Sister...I am sorry I could not tell you!
{np}So...this is death. Frightening, yes...but also peaceful, perhaps.
{np}Never have I been made to crawl upon the ground... I will not forget this shame!
{np}Oz... You've been quite...patient. Now I come to join you.
{np}I...only pray my homeland chooses the correct course...
{np}My apologies... I've made a miscalculation, it seems.
{np}I would have seen...the day when Valeria found her freedom.
{np}I die proud...to have been a part of the Order of {order}!
{np}I am sorry, {hero}... I do not mean to abandon this fight, and yet...I must.
{np}I'm afraid I've come as far as I'm able. Forgive me.
{np}I must depart before I am wounded more grievously than I already am.
{np}King, pawn...and knight. All lie in the same box when the game is done.
{np}{hero}...it falls to you, now, to create that country I so wished to see.
{np}I would have died without regrets...but such was not to be.
{np}Gar! This was an error... I hate to leave a job undone.
{np}Hear me well, boy. You finish this war... Bring peace.
{np}I wanted to die a better death than this... Ah, to see the waves...again.
{np}Your forgiveness. I am unable to carry on this battle today.
{np}What have I done...to die here...
{np}Well, it looks like a hasty retreat is in order. So sorry.
{np}Why? I cannot believe I've lost...and yet...
{np}Very sorry...I just need a little rest.
{np}What...? Why?

{np}It's as we heard, {hero}.
Lanselot's returned.

{np}Then it's time.
Right, Sister?

{np}Time to end this madness.
We can't beat him. You know that.

{np}What are you saying, Catiua?
You'd have us pass up a chance like this?
{np}It's foolishness to think the three of us might defeat the Dark Knights.

{np}They're the ones who've been foolish.
And we stand to gain.
{np}Don't tell me you're scared! If you've lost your taste for blood, I'll do this myself.

{np}That's enough, Vyce.
Let's go.

{np}No... This won't end well.
And what do we "gain" by taking their lives, anyway?

{np}Lanselot is captain of the Dark Knights, and they are the source of Bakram power.{pp}Kill Lanselot, and you remove one of the pillars supporting them. The Bakram {pal 16}will{palreset} falter, if only for a moment.{pp}Yet that moment will be all the encouragement the Galgastani require. They want Valeria for their own, and they will move to take it.
{np}The turmoil of the last war has only just settled, and you'd start another?
{np}Are we Walister so free of turmoil now, Catiua?{pp}We are less than vermin in their eyes―insects to be crushed underfoot.
{np}If war begins anew, we'll die just the same.
{np}Shh! They're here.

{np}We'll flank them!
{hero}, go round behind.
{np}Right.

{np}{FF 9A 04}Once battle begins, units with the lowest Recovery Time (RT) move first. The order in which units move is called the Attack Turn (AT). You can issue commands such as MOVE and ATTACK on a unit's Attack Turn.{pp}To issue a command, place the cursor on one of your units and press the {icon 3} button. A list of available commands will appear.{pp}You cannot issue commands during the Attack Turn of enemies or other units not under your control. However, you can still examine units and perform similar tasks by pressing the {icon 4} button.
{np}Who goes there?
{np}Friends of the Resistance...and no friends of yours!
{np}The Resistance?
{np}I expected a warmer welcome than this! ...Eh? They're children!
{np}Wait. Do you even know who we are?
{np}You're Lanselot, and that makes you my enemy!

{np}Lanselot {pal 16}is{palreset} my name, true.
How is it that you know me?
{np}How could I forget you!? The Dark Knights laid torch to this town only a winter past!

{np}The Dark Knights...?
But we come from the Kingdom of New Xenobia to the east.
{np}And Lanselot of the Dark Knights has but one eye. You have two.
{np}One eye, you say? Would that he lacked my name as well. His reputation, it seems, does me no favors.
{np}No marauding knights us, but mercenaries come looking for work.
{np}I am Lanselot Hamilton, a Holy Knight of Xenobia.
{np}And I am Canopus, the one they name Wind Caller. The old fart here is...
{np}The Star Seer, Warren Omon, at your service.
{np}Mirdyn Walhorn, a Knight of Xenobia, as it please you.

{np}Gildas is my name.
There now, no need to be frightened.

{np}I wasn't―
I...I don't know what to say.
{np}Forgive us, good knights. But perhaps this meeting might benefit us both. We have need of strength such as yours.
{np}Tell us your tale, then. We are strangers in this land, and I would hear more of it.
{np}I'm Vyce...and it would seem you are not our enemy.
{np}I am the sibyl Catiua, and this is my brother, {hero}.

{np}{select 1}{FF 88 02}1{FF 88 02}.{FF 88 01} You must forgive our error.
2. Stay on your guard, Sister.
{np}Please, forgive our mistake.
{np}Already forgotten, though you did give us quite the surprise.{pp}Now, do you think we might talk somewhere out of this wretched heat?
{np}We have just the place. It's not much, but it's secret and it's safe.
{np}Do not be so quick to trust, Sister.{pp}We know nothing of these men save their name, and that only on their word.
{np}You are mistrustful for one so young. Let's leave the children to play amongst themselves, Lanselot.
{np}We mean you no harm. Is the benefit of the doubt too much to ask?

{np}Where are your manners, {hero}?
Apologize at once!

{np}I swear on my blade, on my honor as a knight:
I will be no enemy of yours.

{np}{select 1}{FF 88 02}1{FF 88 02}.{FF 88 01} I'll take you at your word.
2. ...
{np}A good oath. Forgive our mistrust, Lord Knight.
{np}Already forgotten, though you did give us quite a start.{pp}Now, do you think we might talk somewhere out of this wretched heat?

{np}You must forgive my brother.
He is quick to anger.
{np}As it is, we lack swords enough to face the Galgastani.{pp}The Bakram share our deficit...a deficit they've remedied by joining forces with Lodis.
{np}So Lodis sent them the Dark Knights Loslorien.

{np}Loslorien is an order under the direct command of High Priest Sardian, ruler of Lodis.{pp}They are said to be the greatest of the sixteen orders, and the High Priest's favorite besides.{pp}Yet he uses them not in open battle, but in shadows and secrecy.{pp}They are his ears, and when there is need of it, his dagger.{pp}No knights in shining armor, these. In word and deed, they are as dark as their name.
{np}And these Dark Knights whatever-you-call-them are backing the Bakram, neh?
{np}So why are {pal 16}you{palreset} come to our isles? Does Xenobia think to claim Valeria as her own?{pp}Do Lodis and Xenobia mean to bring {pal 16}their{palreset} wars to our shores!?
{np}Enough, Vyce.

{np}Your question deserves an answer, Vyce.
We are Xenobian, after all.{pp}Yet we do not serve as knights of Xenobia.
We were banished. Cast out.

{np}We're outlaws.
No place waiting for us back home, neh?
{np}We've come to find work―preferably of the well-paying variety.

{np}I don't trust you, and I don't trust your story.
This is {pal 16}our{palreset} fight!

{np}Vyce, please.
Lord Knight, you must forgive our passion.

{np}There is nothing to forgive.
Your passion does you credit.{pp}Tell me, what will you do now?
{np}For one, we have to get Duke Ronwey out of Almorica.

{np}Duke Ronwey?
He is your leader?

{np}Not just us. He leads all the Walister.{pp}The Galgastani hold him captive in their castle.
They plan to execute him, if the rumors are to be believed.{pp}We mean to stop them.
